name: Opinions
overview: Scripture warns against placing confidence in human opinions that lack understanding, highlighting the folly of those who delight only in expressing their own hearts rather than seeking wisdom. Believers are called to avoid harsh judgment of others, recognizing that valuing the approval of men above God's praise leads to spiritual compromise. The Word encourages receiving those weak in faith with grace, without engaging in contentious debates over doubtful matters, as such disputes can cause God's name to be blasphemed among unbelievers. Ultimately, the Bible teaches reliance on God's truth rather than the fleeting and fallible breath of man.
